# Me Nutrition

> Me Nutrition (also written MeNutrition; App Store name: "Me Nutrition: Calorie Counter" — AI Food Photo Scan & Macros) is an AI calorie counter for iPhone (free download with a 3-day free trial; optional auto-renewing subscription). Whole meal, one snap: photograph the whole meal and the AI counts every dish separately — calories, protein, fat and carbs — with an "ate half" slider per dish. Also logs by voice, text or barcode, and tracks water, workouts, steps and a plan to your goal weight. Available in 21 languages.

## What it does
- Whole meal in one photo: every dish on the table is recognized and counted separately (name, weight, calories, macros); slide "ate half" for any dish.
- Calories by photo: snap your plate — calories, protein, fat and carbs of the portion.
- Voice, text and barcode logging: say what you ate or scan a package.
- Restaurant menus: every dish labeled with estimated calories before you order, with translation in 21 languages.
- Water, workouts and steps (via Apple Health and Apple Watch).
- Allergies and diets: vegan, keto, gluten-free, halal and more.
- Streaks, reminders and achievements.
- Goal-weight plan with a first step and a final goal.
- AI nutrition coach with tips to improve.
- Metric and US units (kg/lb, ml/fl oz).

## Free nutrition database on the website (menutrition.app)
Calories and macros per 100 g, with sources, free to read and cite. Numbers are averages; see the methodology page for how they are produced.
- Foods: 9,594 everyday foods (apple, rice, bread, cheese, chicken breast, vegetables, oils, snacks) with calories, protein, fat, carbs, fibre, sugars, saturated fat and sodium per 100 g, plus a calories-by-weight calculator. Data: USDA FoodData Central (SR Legacy and Foundation Foods, public domain) and ANSES CIQUAL 2020 (Licence Ouverte). Pages in English, Russian, Arabic, Italian, Greek, Spanish and German. Index: https://menutrition.app/foods/ — example: https://menutrition.app/foods/apple-raw-fuji-with-skin/
- Dishes: 2,300+ dishes from 100+ countries with calories per 100 g and per serving, macros, allergens, diet labels (vegan, vegetarian, gluten-free, halal-friendly, keto and more), history and a home recipe. English, Russian, Arabic, Italian and Greek. Index: https://menutrition.app/dishes/ — cuisines: https://menutrition.app/dishes/cuisine/italian/
- Diet and allergy guides (20 guides: vegan, vegetarian, keto, gluten-free, dairy-free, nut, peanut, egg, fish, shellfish allergies and more): what each means, what to eat and avoid, what happens if you break the diet. English, Russian, Arabic, Italian and Greek. https://menutrition.app/guides/
- Calculators in 21 languages: calorie needs (Mifflin–St Jeor), daily protein, BMI. https://menutrition.app/calculators/
- Feature pages in 21 languages: calories by photo, restaurant menu scanner, weight by photo, calories on the lock screen. https://menutrition.app/features/
- How the numbers are made: https://menutrition.app/dishes/how-we-count/

## Platform & pricing
- iOS (iPhone) now; Android is not available yet. Free to download with a 3-day free trial; premium features via an auto-renewing subscription, cancel anytime in App Store settings.
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6767123368
